---
title: "siunitx HTML example"
format: html
filters:
  - siunitx
siunitx:
  detect-all: true
  per-mode: symbol
  inter-unit-product: '\ensuremath{{}\cdot{}}'
  range-units: single
  range-phrase: '\text{ to }'
  print-unity-mantissa: false
  list-units: single
  list-final-separator: '\text{ to }'
  separate-uncertainty: true
  multi-part-units: single
---

Inline example: $\SI{9.81}{\meter\per\second\squared}$

Plain unit: $\si{\kilo\gram\per\meter\cubed}$

Number formatting: $\num{1.23}$ and $\numrange{1.5}{2.5}$

List: $\SIlist{1; 2; 3}{\newton}$

Range: $\SIrange{3}{5}{\milli\meter}$

Angle: $\ang{30;15;20}$

Math still works: $E = m c^2$ with $m = \SI{2}{\kilogram}$.
